rows.title: L3 specialized intelligence organ family
rows.intended_function: A diverse but canonical set of bounded organs, each callable, governed, typed, routed, verified, tested, integrated, observable and useful; installing a library is not implementing an intelligence.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Ten enabled cortex entries (router, Z3 formal, CP-SAT, Fermi, evidence/causal, semantic, deterrence/accountability, schedule extraction, graph/search, continuous LP) plus formed functions and the GREG built-in family manifests on one registry/receipt envelope. Reserved families remain disabled in seed_registry.
rows.substrate: Python with pinned open-source solvers; optional loopback local model; no vendor as constitutional infrastructure.
rows.input_contract: ProblemGeometry plus per-organ schemas; incomplete formalization abstains.
rows.output_contract: cortex-proof-artifact and cortex-receipt with authority_created=false, execution_authority=none.
rows.epistemic_type: Per organ; receipts separate formal validity, empirical validity and legitimate authority.
rows.verifier: Adversarial verification plus engine-specific certificates; import boundary test forbids cortex importing Consequence Gate/adapters/actuators.
rows.integration_path: Extend existing organs or qualify reserved profiles through the one genome/registry; formed functions only via founder-attached capability path; never duplicate canonical organs.
rows.routing_eligibility: Hard eligibility before ranking; reserved/withheld organs cannot be selected; aggregate solver budget enforced before formed execution.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — integration tests and fresh-clone replication are not external customer outcomes.
rows.blocker: Several organs blocked on founder attach, real outcomes, calibration, human participants or reachable local model; see per-organ rows.
rows.next_build: Execute partition queue by causal dependency, beginning with VOI then metaconsensus; organ-specific next builds below.
rows.dependency: docs/cortex/dependency-partition-2026-10-03.json; canonical Kernel attach for activation.
rows.completion_criterion: Every A-Y row reaches its own completion criterion with honest status; no row is marked complete from documentation or installed dependencies alone.

Loopback 127.0.0.1 only; no automatic paid fallback.

rows.input_contract: Source text/schema for semantic; controlled schedule grammar for extraction; literal free-text intake only at B50 addendum boundary.
rows.output_contract: sourced_claims with exact spans or typed extraction artifacts; ABSTAIN when model unavailable.
rows.epistemic_type: semantic; strategic only where explicitly classified; never unsourced factual assertion.
rows.verifier: Quoted-span constraints, schedule composition round trips, semantic-unavailable example, held-out arms NOT_RUN without model.

rows.dependency: R05.1 local model infrastructure; B51/B52 for deeper intake/learning.
rows.completion_criterion: Live local-model semantic path passes frozen evaluation against real infrastructure while deterministic extraction remains certified and unsourced claims remain impossible.

rows.title: C — Fermi/estimation intelligence
rows.intended_function: Decision-grade bounded estimates with explicit assumptions, dependent uncertainty, sensitivity and reference-class discipline.

rows.output_contract: bounded_estimate artifact with intervals, sensitivity, assumptions and provenance.
rows.epistemic_type: estimate; not causal and not external validation.
rows.verifier: Deterministic seeded tests, dependent-input examples, adversarial review of assumptions, freeze manifests for reported runs.

rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible for estimation geometry; abstains on missing inputs/dependency.
rows.blocker: External calibration requires real outcomes (R12.2).
rows.next_build: No core rebuild; connect outcome calibration when real outcomes exist.
rows.dependency: numpy/scipy; canonical outcome records for calibration.
rows.completion_criterion: Met for bounded estimation mechanics; calibrated real-world performance remains a separate unmet evidence gate.

rows.title: D — formal SAT/SMT/Z3 intelligence
rows.intended_function: Deductive constraint solving and entailment with witnesses, UNSAT and a completeness gate from requirements to model.

rows.output_contract: formal_model artifacts, witnesses, UNSAT, entailment results.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive / constraint_feasibility.
rows.verifier: Independent engine re-check, brute force small instances, mutation checks, completeness-gate tests.
rows.integration_path: B07 extends the same formal organ/contracts for temporal, deontic and bounded first-order theories; no new authority for deontic conclusions.
rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible with complete supported formalization; otherwise abstain/handoff.
rows.blocker: Temporal/deontic/first-order extensions unbuilt; deontic output remains normative and cannot create legal authority.
rows.next_build: B07 formal extensions (partition queue item 9), each with theory-specific verifier and abstention.
rows.dependency: z3-solver theories; contract extensions; normative handoff rules.
rows.completion_criterion: Current core met; each added theory has completeness mapping, witnesses/checks and tests proving unsupported theories abstain rather than approximate silently.

rows.dependency: ortools; shared model schema; F-OPTIMIZATION coordination.
rows.completion_criterion: Core met; broader completion requires the new model classes to solve with independently checked witnesses/certificates and routing tests.

rows.completion_criterion: Each supported OR class returns certificate-backed status, is independently checked, and is exercised through real ProblemGeometry routing.

rows.title: G — graph/network intelligence
rows.intended_function: Network reasoning with inspectable, independently checkable graph answers.

rows.title: I — probabilistic/Bayesian intelligence
rows.intended_function: Explicit probabilistic updating and prediction that distinguishes uncertainty from ignorance.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG probabilistic beta_update solver with posterior proof class; estimation organ supplies Monte Carlo uncertainty; unresolved class preserves ignorance. cortex.probabilistic.bayes remains reserved/disabled — the GREG mechanism does not make that cortex organ enabled.
rows.input_contract: Prior and observation counts for Beta update; declared distributions for estimation.
rows.output_contract: posterior / bounded_estimate artifacts with assumptions; no posterior from absent prior/input.
rows.epistemic_type: prediction / estimate; ignorance remains unresolved.
rows.verifier: Conjugate-update unit tests and deterministic estimation tests; future calibration against real outcomes.
rows.integration_path: Extend GREG probabilistic family contracts; cortex Bayesian organ only through reserved attach plus evidence, sharing one receipt envelope.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG probabilistic eligible; cortex bayes withheld.
rows.blocker: A06/B11: founder attach for cortex family and real outcomes for calibration; richer Bayesian models unbuilt.
rows.next_build: No unscheduled cortex activation; when attached, begin with conjugate models already present in GREG and prove calibration on real records.
rows.dependency: Founder attach; real outcomes; optional scipy.
rows.completion_criterion: Bounded Bayesian updates are correct and tested now; cortex completion requires enabled qualification plus calibrated predictions with ignorance never encoded as false precision.

rows.title: J — causal intelligence
rows.intended_function: Causal identification and effect estimation only under explicit designs/assumptions; correlation must never silently become causation.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.evidence_causal@0.1.0 with identification gating, refutations, bootstrap confidence intervals, provenance and contradictions; GREG causal treatment_effect family.
rows.input_contract: Causal query, identifying design/assumptions, data/evidence and provenance.
rows.output_contract: causal_identification artifact or UNIDENTIFIED with missing resolving information.
rows.epistemic_type: causal only when identified; otherwise prediction/unresolved.
rows.verifier: Refutation tests, unmeasured-confounding abstention examples, adversarial verification.

rows.routing_eligibility: Eligible for causal/evidence geometry; non-identification is a first-class result.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — fixtures do not establish real effects.
rows.blocker: Real causal validation needs external intervention/outcome data.
rows.next_build: B34 passive causal-credit receipt fields; no stronger claims without designs and outcomes.
rows.dependency: Identifying evidence; canonical outcomes.
rows.completion_criterion: Mechanics met; any real causal claim must cite identified external evidence and survive refutation.

rows.output_contract: control_trace with proposed bounded control values; no actuator effect.
rows.epistemic_type: physical; proposals only, never authority.
rows.verifier: Deterministic trajectory/unit tests and bound checks; any physical effect requires separate authorized adapters outside cortex.

rows.routing_eligibility: GREG control eligible read-only; cortex feedback withheld.

rows.next_build: No activation; define stability/bounds tests when a real homeostatic deficit is named.
rows.dependency: Founder attach; real sensor/outcome data; Kernel authorization for any effect.
rows.completion_criterion: Solver met at GREG level; cortex completion requires bounded stability tests and explicit authority separation under a real authorized use case.

rows.intended_function: Sequential decisions under explicit state/action/reward/transition models with bounded exploration and honest comparison.

rows.verifier: Known-MDP dynamic-programming tests; future frozen comparisons against constituent/simple routes.

rows.next_build: No activation; build frozen known-MDP comparisons before any bandit qualification.
rows.dependency: Founder attach; evaluation evidence; real outcomes for learning.
rows.completion_criterion: Current MDP solver tested; sequential cortex completion requires demonstrated gains over simpler routes and bounded, authorized exploration only.

rows.title: M — active-inference/active-perception intelligence
rows.intended_function: Choose observations/actions that reduce task-relevant uncertainty under a bounded model, rather than passively scoring all information equally.

rows.input_contract: Not enabled; future contract must declare beliefs, observation options, costs and bounded action proposal scope.
rows.output_contract: Reserved; nearest current outputs are information_value and bounded_test/handoff receipts.
rows.epistemic_type: prediction / strategic; generated beliefs are not world evidence.
rows.verifier: No active loop to verify; future gate must test value against passive VOI and prohibit unauthorized action.
rows.integration_path: Compile the biological/inspired concept to an explicit mechanism at registration; build on N-VOI rather than a parallel perception stack; reserved attach required.
rows.routing_eligibility: Withheld (reserved); no route may select cortex.meta.active_inference.
rows.blocker: Reserved-family attach plus a real perception/evidence deficit; no authorized active-perception environment.
rows.next_build: First deliver N-VOI and metaconsensus; only then define an active-observation experiment if its expected value beats passive VOI.
rows.dependency: cortex.meta.active_inference reserved gate; L3-N-VOI; real observation/outcome channel.
rows.completion_criterion: A bounded observation-selection mechanism demonstrates measurable gain over passive VOI on frozen tasks and remains read-only unless separately authorized.

rows.intended_function: Value resolving information by its ability to change a consequential decision, including when to stop acquiring information.

rows.verifier: Analytic small-decision cases, zero/negative-value cases, independence from fabricated probabilities, adversarial checks.
rows.integration_path: Build behind reserved cortex.information.voi gate using existing GREG information mechanism and canonical receipts; integrate with routing/metabolism, not a second decision system.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG information eligible; new cortex VOI withheld until qualified.
rows.blocker: No external blocker for a bounded deterministic VOI organ slice; reserved activation remains governed.
rows.next_build: SELECTED NEXT after completed 0.4.0 composition: A12/A38/B17 VOI organ cortex.information.voi behind reserved gate, with tests and routing examples (partition queue item 1).

rows.completion_criterion: VOI changes a declared acquire/stop/abstain decision in analytic tests, refuses fabricated inputs, is routed through ProblemGeometry and never creates authority.

rows.completion_criterion: GREG mechanism met; cortex completion requires measured detection quality and explicit non-causal typing under routing.

rows.title: S — adversarial intelligence
rows.intended_function: Attack conclusions from other intelligences, find counterexamples/shared assumptions and prevent unsupported recommendation.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.verifier.adversarial@0.1.0 model-free attack with findings, shared-dependency recording and critical blocks on recommend; repository mutation checks and preserved failing verifier runs.
rows.substrate: Python stdlib plus solver-specific checkers; no model required.
rows.input_contract: Candidate artifact, geometry, evidence, route and verification material.
rows.output_contract: Findings with severity, counterarguments and blocked/allowed disposition effects.
rows.epistemic_type: deductive/adversarial evidence about the artifact; does not prove external truth.
rows.verifier: Mutation testing verifies the verifier; independent fresh-clone replication; failures preserved rather than deleted.
rows.integration_path: Mandatory canonical verification stage; metaconsensus will consume findings without averaging dissent.
rows.routing_eligibility: Runs after solver routes; critical findings block recommend.
rows.real_world_evidence: Verifier FAIL then PASS and fresh-clone replication are real executed engineering evidence, not commercial validation.
rows.blocker: Coverage limited to implemented attack types; no adversary can prove absence of all flaws.
rows.next_build: Add attack types with each new organ; wire findings into B30 metaconsensus.
rows.dependency: Artifact-specific checkers; independent engines where possible.
rows.completion_criterion: Met for current artifact types; every new intelligence must ship adversarial attacks and negative evidence before eligibility.

rows.verifier: Reserved; future model must be executable, replayable and falsified against held-out observations.

rows.routing_eligibility: Withheld (reserved).
rows.blocker: B28 founder attach plus evidence; no measured demand for a separate organ beyond existing executable models.
rows.next_build: No independent build ahead of VOI/metaconsensus; first reuse existing executable models and record the deficit if composition fails.

rows.intended_function: Structured elicitation, human judgment, panels and accountable handoffs where legitimacy, values or lived evidence are required.

rows.title: V — heterogeneous model routing over replaceable substrates
rows.intended_function: Route tasks across multiple replaceable model/tool substrates by capability, cost and evidence without any vendor becoming constitutional infrastructure.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Semantic/proposer interfaces isolate the model behind loopback local endpoints and abstain when unavailable; catalog manifests make solver substrates replaceable. Only a single configured local model path exists; no heterogeneous multi-model router or paid fallback.
rows.substrate: OpenAI-compatible loopback client boundary; open/local models preferred; solver substrates sympy/z3/ortools/networkx/scipy.
rows.input_contract: Task geometry plus substrate manifests, cost/latency and evidence requirements; current live model input limited to configured local endpoint.
rows.output_contract: Route/receipt identifying actual substrate; unavailable model yields ABSTAIN/NOT_RUN, never a simulated answer.
rows.epistemic_type: Semantic/model output remains model-output evidence tier; solver proofs retain their own proof classes.
rows.verifier: Frozen cross-substrate comparisons, deterministic replay where possible, availability/abstention tests; no vendor claim without execution.
rows.integration_path: Extend existing catalog/proposer/semantic interfaces to multiple substrates behind the one router; do not create a model-owned authority or routing plane.
rows.routing_eligibility: Local configured model only for semantic; deterministic organs route normally; unavailable substrates ineligible.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — live local model unreachable in sandbox; no multi-substrate external comparison.
rows.blocker: B61 is a preserved destination requiring real substrates, access authority and comparative outcomes; reachable founder model infrastructure absent (R05.1).
rows.next_build: Build substrate-neutral contracts through current VOI/geometry work; defer plural live routing until at least two lawful real substrates and frozen comparisons exist.
rows.dependency: Real model substrates; founder-authorized access/cost; R05.1; evaluation freezes.
rows.completion_criterion: At least two real replaceable substrates are compared on frozen tasks, routed by measured utility with abstention and cost bounds, and any one can be removed without constitutional failure.

rows.title: W — program synthesis/algorithm construction
rows.directive_ref: L3 W; review A16/B24; Capability Genesis GENERATE
rows.intended_function: Construct new algorithms/programs from a declared deficit, then test, adversarially test, verify and reject or register them; invention only after acquire/qualify/adapt/compose are exhausted.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.developmental.program_synthesis reserved/disabled; CAPABILITY_DEFICIT and formed-function capability-genesis precedent exist, but GREG does not autonomously synthesize and register new organs. Mechanism Recombination Foundry is a collaboration method, not an executable synthesizer.
rows.substrate: Reserved Python profile; any generated code must run sandboxed with open/local toolchains.
rows.input_contract: Future typed deficit, specification, examples, resource bounds and forbidden effects; not enabled now.
rows.output_contract: Candidate program plus tests/proofs and REJECT or registration proposal; no self-activation or authority.
rows.epistemic_type: Deductive only where proven; generated program behavior otherwise sandbox-execution evidence, not external truth.
rows.verifier: Specification tests, adversarial/fuzz cases, sandbox execution, independent review, formed-function verification before any attach.
rows.integration_path: Use Capability Genesis and existing deficit/formed-function/Kernel attach path; Founder/authorized-human activation; no second registry or self-modifying authority.
rows.routing_eligibility: Withheld; deficits abstain/escalate rather than route to an unregistered synthesizer.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no GREG-synthesized organ exists; human/AI-collaboration built organs are not autonomous synthesis.
rows.blocker: A16/B24/B56: real measured deficit, sandbox evidence, founder attach and N4 gate; no real deficit/outcome stream.
rows.next_build: Maintain honest deficit reporting; acquire/compose existing mechanisms first. Do not build autonomous synthesis without the N4/founder gates.
rows.dependency: Capability Genesis N4; sandbox execution; independent verification; founder attach; Mechanism Recombination Foundry for necessary invention.
rows.completion_criterion: A real deficit yields a generated candidate that passes specification, adversarial, sandbox and independent verification, is explicitly authorized for registration, and demonstrably improves real routing without authority growth.

rows.title: Y — Levin-inspired developmental intelligence

rows.intended_function: Multi-scale bounded competency, light-cone-limited information use, repair/reorganization and developmental composition compiled to engineering mechanisms without consciousness/personhood claims.

rows.epistemic_type: Per composed organ; developmental claims require observed functional evidence.
rows.verifier: Composition/cell tests, cap honesty, independent artifact verification and explicit limits (not general homeostasis or autonomous persistent goals).
rows.integration_path: Extend cells/composition and canonical developmental ownership; functional morphogenesis tracked separately in L4; no second learning/routing plane.
rows.routing_eligibility: Existing cells/composition eligible under current gates; reserved developmental profiles withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no real repair/reorganization outcome stream.

rows.completion_criterion: Demonstrated bounded repair/reorganization under perturbation with measured functional recovery, explicit light-cone limits, no biological claims and no authority self-expansion.
